4. By way of this application under Section 482 of the Code NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/20615/2022 ORDER DATED: 11/08/2023 undefined of Criminal Procedure, 1973, the applicants have prayed to quash and set aside the complaint being FIR No.11210031220236 registered with Mahila Police Station for the offences under Sections 498A, 504, 506(2) and 114 of IPC and sections 3 & 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act and all consequential proceedings arising therefrom.

5. Learned advocates for the respective parties submitted that during the pendency of proceedings,
the parties have settled the dispute amicably and pursuant to such mutual settlement, the original complainant has also filed an Affidavit, which is on record.

In the Affidavit, the original complainant has categorically stated that the dispute with the applicants has been resolved amicably and that he has no objection, if the present proceedings are quashed and set aside since there is no surviving grievance between them.

6. Having heard learned advocates on both the sides and considering the facts and circumstances of the case as also the principle laid down by the Apex Court in the cases of - (i) Gian Singh Vs. State of Punjab & Anr., reported in (2012) 10 SCC 303, (ii) Madan Mohan Abbot Vs. State of Punjab,
reported in (2008) 4 SCC 582, (iii) Nikhil Merchant Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation & Anr.,
reported in 2009 (1) GLH 31,
(iv) Manoj Sharma Vs. State & Ors., reported in 2009 (1) GLH NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/20615/2022 ORDER DATED: 11/08/2023 undefined 190 and (v) Narinder Singh & Ors.
Vs. State of Punjab & Anr. reported in 2014 (2) Crime 67 (SC), in the opinion of this Court, the further continuation of criminal proceedings against the applicants in relation to the impugned FIR would cause unnecessary harassment to the applicants.

7.
In the result, the application is allowed.

The impugned complaint being FIR No.11210031220236 registered with Mahila Police Station as well as all consequential proceedings initiated in pursuance thereof are hereby quashed and set aside qua the applicants herein.
Rule is made absolute.
Direct service is permitted.
If the applicants are in jail, the jail authority concerned is directed to release the applicants forthwith, if they are not required in connection with any other case.

Consequently,
the interim application also stands disposed of.
